lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular clusters is positioned posterior to the branchial region. The arrangement consists of approximately four horizontal rows, with a distinct vertical column of five spots located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal light-toned regions, forming a lattice where the high-luminance circular spots serve as anchor nodes at the primary intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high-reflectance on the dorsal side to deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of diffuse, high-luminance blobs is visible strictly within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior and mid-sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct elongated, dark-toned features (ectoparasites or remoras) are attached to the posterior-ventral surface of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more uniform pattern on the lateral flank.
